D_SCT_E01_S01_01.text: The sun comes through and kisses her face / Through open window drapes.

D_SCT_E01_S02_01.text: If I can make it all fit together / If I can just figure it out.

D_SCT_E02_S01_01.text: Hey Ho / Let's go / These times are tough / But even so.

D_SCT_E03_S01_01.text: Your love’s a fire that burns so true / A shelter when the wild winds blow.

D_SCT_E04_S01_01.text: Like the ache of a phantom limb / I reach for the air where you’ve always been.

D_SCT_E04_S02_01.text: I wanted to be somebody / I wanted my own theme song.

D_SCT_E05_S01_01.text: Don’t fix the cracks / Don’t mend the seams / Let me chase these runaway dreams.

D_SCT_E05_S02_01.text: Here I am / Hanging on the edge now.

D_SCT_E06_S01_01.text: When will I see you again?

D_SCT_E06_S02_01.text: Everything you said was true / Everything you said was fair.

D_SCT_E07_S01_01.text: No control, no need to steer / Just this motion pulling me clear.

D_SCT_E07_S02_01.text: It’s tangy, it’s sour / It’s sugary sweet.

D_SCT_E08_S01_01.text: Watch the world as it turns in fading days / An empire burns and crumbles down.

D_SCT_E08_S02_01.text: I don’t need to know why / She’s here in my life / Just feels right.
